integrity_notes: A universal geometric proof establishes all pairs. A self-contained standard-library checker confirms one explicit exact example and is not substituted for the general proof. An earlier equivalent Segre-formulation is a residual originality risk; no independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers only: smooth coordinate-tangent quadrics, Hadamard products of two lines, fixed coordinates. The exact two-orbit classification is set-theoretic; it does not assert reducedness or a scheme structure for the incidence fiber. No singular, real, or higher-degree cases are claimed.
title: The inverse Hadamard line problem for a smooth coordinate-tangent quadric has exactly two torus orbits
